title: Dependency metadata verification disabled
description: verification-metadata.xml declares a verification-metadata file that switches metadata verification off. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a verification-metadata file that switches metadata verification off.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a verification-metadata file that switches metadata verification off.
limitation: It matches a verification-metadata file that switches metadata verification off in the parsed verification-metadata.xml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
